streams.name: PLAYER_ANIM_INTERACTION_CAMERA_RESPONSE
state_writes: ED at 0x001226B4 writes player interaction animation state field 0xF0E7 to 1
ED at 0x001226C6 writes player interaction response field 0xF0E9 to 0xFF
streams.handoff: F8 at 0x001226CC -> dynamic player animation state selection
streams.selector: Player_ProcessInteractionState selects this stream in CAMERA_SPECIAL_MODE and arms PLAYER_INTERACTION_ANIMATION_GATE plus SCENE_SCRIPT_COUNTDOWN.

streams.name: PLAYER_ANIM_INTERACTION_RECOVERY
streams.handoff: F8 at 0x001226E2 -> dynamic player animation state selection
selectors: Player_ProcessInteractionState selects this stream for normal interaction recovery when pending/state locks are clear
ActorType15_PlayerCollisionHandler selects this stream after its shared collision block when player action-response field 0xF0D8 is clear

streams.name: PLAYER_ANIM_ACTION_SPECIAL_CAMERA
streams.state_writes: ED writes player action-response field 0xF0D8 to 1 after each frame phase
streams.handoff: F8 at 0x00122718 -> dynamic player animation state selection
streams.selector: Player_SelectActionAnimation selects this stream when CAMERA_SPECIAL_MODE is nonzero and the action query succeeds.

streams.name: PLAYER_ANIM_TYPE1E_COLLISION_RESPONSE
streams.handoff: F8 at 0x001227D0 -> dynamic player animation state selection
streams.selector: ActorType1E_PlayerCollisionHandler selects this variant when TERRAIN_LANDING_STATE is active, PLAYER_INTERACTION_TRANSITION_LOCK is clear, and player action-response field 0xF0D8 equals 1.

streams.name: PLAYER_ANIM_TYPE1E_COLLISION_RESPONSE_ALTERNATE
streams.handoff: F8 at 0x001228AA -> dynamic player animation state selection
streams.selector: ActorType1E_PlayerCollisionHandler selects this variant under the same landing/transition gates when player action-response field 0xF0D8 is not 1.

boundaries.stream_group: The five entries are independently bounded by exact F8 terminators and adjacent roots: 0x001226B2/0x001226CE/0x001226E4 end at 0x001226CD/0x001226E3/0x00122719, and the Type-1E responses end at 0x001227D1 and 0x001228AB immediately before their adjacent action roots.

conclusion: The interaction-response bridge is now named and range-bounded. Camera-special interaction recovery arms the presentation gate and scene countdown, normal recovery is shared with the Type-0x15 collision path, special-camera action has its own state-publication stream, and Type-0x1E collision response selects one of two sound-producing presentation variants based on the action-response state field.
